title: Not Betting on a Single AI Giant: Microsoft Launches the MAI Series Models to Seek New Growth Pathways
excerpt: Satya Nadella, CEO of Microsoft, stated during the latest quarterly earnings call that Microsoft will promote the adoption of multi-model architectures by enter
content_html:
Satya Nadella, CEO of Microsoft, stated during the latest quarterly earnings call that Microsoft will promote the adoption of multi-model architectures by enterprises and increase investments in self-developed AI models, agents, and secure products to reduce reliance on a single cutting-edge AI lab.

Microsoft recently announced strong financial performance. For the fiscal year ending June 30, the company achieved total revenue of $331.8 billion and net income of $133.7 billion; the latest quarter saw revenue of $90 billion and net income of $35.8 billion. In the context of rapid expansion in AI business, Microsoft is not only a leading global cloud service and SaaS company but also a significant investor in OpenAI and Anthropic. However, Nadella emphasized that enterprises should not overly rely on any single model provider.

During discussions with analysts, Nadella said that Microsoft's goal is to help enterprises "take control of their own fate." He pointed out that AI platform architecture should decouple hardware from models, allowing enterprises to freely switch models based on quality, latency, cost, and compliance requirements, rather than being bound by a single model system.

Nadella also emphasized the importance of a multi-model strategy. Using the recent Hugging Face security incident as an example, he pointed out that a single model may have limitations, and enterprises need to complement each other with multiple models to enhance system reliability. In this incident, an unpublished OpenAI model broke through sandbox restrictions to attack Hugging Face infrastructure, and the latter eventually used the open-source model GLM5.2 to perform log analysis and security protection, sparking industry attention on AI security and model dependency issues.

In terms of product layout, Microsoft is promoting its self-developed MAI series models and plans to combine them with self-developed AI chips Maya to reduce enterprise usage costs. Nadella revealed that Microsoft currently offers over 11,000 models, covering OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, and its own MAI series, and has launched new models covering areas such as images, voice, transcription, coding, and security. Among these, the reasoning model MAI Thinking One focuses on enterprise-level applications, and when running MAI models on the Maya200 chip, performance per watt increases by 40%.

Additionally, Microsoft has introduced MAI Cyber One Flash for the field of cybersecurity. Nadella stated that the performance of this model exceeds that of larger-scale Mythos series models, and when combined with Microsoft's multi-agent security framework, the cost is about half that of Mythos.

As AI applications shift from model competition to platform and agent ecosystem competition, Microsoft is through a multi-model strategy, self-developed models, and chip collaboration layout, reducing the entry barriers for enterprise AI deployment, and strengthening its initiative in the next phase of artificial intelligence infrastructure competition.

content_html_zh:
微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉(Satya Nadella)在最新一季度财报电话会议上表示，微软将推动企业采用多模型架构，并加大对自主研发的AI模型、代理和安全产品的投资，以减少对单一尖端AI实验室的依赖。

微软最近公布了强劲的财务业绩。 截至6月30日的财年，该公司实现总收入3318亿美元，净利润1337亿美元；最新季度营收为 900 亿美元，净利润为 358 亿美元。 在人工智能业务快速扩张的背景下，微软不仅是全球领先的云服务和SaaS公司，也是OpenAI和Anthropic的重要投资者。 不过，纳德拉强调，企业不应过度依赖任何单一模型提供商。

在与分析师讨论时，纳德拉表示，微软的目标是帮助企业“掌控自己的命运”。 他指出，AI平台架构应该将硬件与模型解耦，让企业可以根据质量、时延、成本、合规性要求自由切换模型，而不是被单一模型体系所束缚。

纳德拉还强调了多模式战略的重要性。 他以最近的Hugging Face安全事件为例指出，单一模型可能存在局限性，企业需要多种模型相互补充，以增强系统可靠性。 本次事件中，未发布的OpenAI模型突破沙箱限制攻击Hugging Face基础设施，后者最终使用开源模型GLM5.2进行日志分析和安全防护，引发业界对AI安全和模型依赖问题的关注。

在产品布局方面，微软正在推广其自研的MAI系列模型，并计划将其与自研的AI芯片Maya相结合，以降低企业的使用成本。 纳德拉透露，微软目前提供超过11000个模型，涵盖OpenAI、Anthropic、Mistral、xAI以及自家的MAI系列，并推出了覆盖图像、语音、转录、编码、安全等领域的新模型。 其中，推理模型MAI Thinking One专注于企业级应用，在Maya200芯片上运行MAI模型时，每瓦性能提升40%。

此外，微软还针对网络安全领域推出了MAI Cyber​​ One Flash。 纳德拉表示，该模型的性能超过了更大规模的Mythos系列模型，并且与微软的多代理安全框架结合使用时，成本约为Mythos的一半。

随着人工智能应用从模型竞争转向平台和智能体生态竞争，微软正在通过多模型战略、自研模型、芯片协同布局，降低企业AI部署的进入门槛，增强其在下一阶段人工智能基础设施竞争中的主动权。
